info.title: Rustic Cloud API
info.description: Accounts, social, cosmetics store, servers/domains and GDPR endpoints of Rustic Cloud. Errors use the `ErrorBody` envelope. Realtime frames (`ClientMessage`/`ServerMessage`) travel over the realtime service WebSocket.

A marketplace file. Public ones: counted, then redirected to the CDN. Private, pending or
taken-down ones: streamed to their owner or an admin (bearer token or a signed link).

Paid creator content: refused while creator sales are off (`CREATOR_SALES_ENABLED`, default
off, no Stripe Connect yet). Free content goes to the library instead.

Uploads one file, checked before it is kept (staged for 24 h until a publish request uses
it). The body is the raw bytes (`Content-Type: application/octet-stream`).

get.summary:
Staff picks: the featured server listings (ADR 0158) by rank, then any row still active in the
legacy table (older back-offices). Player counts come from the cloud's last ping.
Players met recently who could become friends (ADR 0145).

`GET /v1/integrations/discord/contact/{id}`: the notice the bot posts for the staff (no email
address, a short excerpt only).

Counts one "Play" press from the launcher (the trending signal). Anonymous: only a per-day
total is stored; the same player (account, else address) counts once per listing and 6 hours.

get.summary:
Exact-match lookup before a friend request (ADR 0145). Same checks and error codes as
`friend_request_send`, so blocked users and accounts that may not receive requests are
indistinguishable (`cannot_add_friend`); the relation is returned instead of the conflicts.

AccountSettings.description:
`GET /v1/me/settings`: the account settings stored server-side and shared by the website
and the launcher (ADR 0168). Display name, country and language stay on `/v1/me`.

play_stats.description: The launcher reports play sessions for the profile's statistics (default on).

bio.description: Short text on the profile (at most 160 characters).

email_news.description: Product news by email (opt-in, default off).

show_role.description: Staff only: show the staff role on the profile (default on).

server_address.description: Only forwarded to friends when the user marked the server as shareable.

zone.description: Registrable zone; defaults to the last two labels of `hostname`.

live.description: Shown right now (active and inside its window).

AdminCollection.description: A collection as staff see it.

AdminDiscordCase.description: A moderation case. Discord ids are strings (they exceed JavaScript's safe integers).

oneOf.description: The Rustic account linked to the target, if any.

in_force.description: Still in force (a ban not lifted, a mute not over, a warning not cleared).

revocable.description: Can be revoked from the back-office (bans, mutes and warnings, not yet revoked).

recent_actions.description: The back-office's latest requests to the bot, newest first.

configured.description:
Saved from the back-office (otherwise the bot runs on its environment and these are
the built-in defaults).

AdminFeaturedServer.description: A featured server as staff see it.

needs_guardian.description: Below the digital consent age of the account's country without a linked guardian.

AdminHeroMedia.description: The back-office's view of the hero video.

default_id.description: The id of the set built into the API (what "Restore the default" brings back).

available.description: Sets found in the CDN folder (`media/hero/<id>/manifest.json`), newest first.

AdminLinkedAccount.description: A linked identity: `microsoft`, `discord` or `game` (a verified game profile).

AdminNewsActivity.description: An entry as staff see it in the back-office.

AdminNewsContributor.description: A contributor as staff see it in the back-office.

AdminNewsItem.description: A news item as staff see it (drafts included).

refunds.description: Refunds of the order, oldest first (ADR 0171).

refundable_minor.description: What can still be refunded (0 unless paid).

paid_totals.description: Sum of `total_minor` of the paid orders matching the filters, per currency.

oneOf.description: Null once anonymised (account deleted).

refunded_minor.description: Refunded so far (Stripe's cumulative amount; the whole total once `refunded`).

AdminProduct.description: A product as staff see it (inactive ones included).

trending_rank.description: 1 = most trending; null when not trending.

redeemed_count.description: Orders holding the code (pending, awaiting a guardian or paid).

discount_given.description: Discounts granted on paid orders, per currency.

source.description: `admin` (the back-office) or `stripe` (seen in a webhook: the Stripe dashboard).

refunded_totals.description: Succeeded refunds of the filtered rows, per currency.

current.description:
The version updates install now (the launcher feed's version, the edition channel's
newest stable build).

oneOf.description: From the launcher's anonymous daily ping; none for edition builds (not reported).

source.description:
`files` (the API reads the CDN folder and can act), `cdn` (read over HTTPS only,
read-only), `none` (no manifest reachable).

writable.description: Pull / restore / pre-release act (the manifests are writable by the API).

AdminSearchResult.description: The top bar's search: accounts, projects, servers and (admins) orders.

AdminUserRef.description: An account as the back-office names it (staff only: carries the email).

AdminUserRow.description: A row of the accounts table.

official.description: The official Rustic publisher (ADR 0166): never editable here.

AdminUserSheet.description: Everything staff need about one account.

ip.description: Caller address when recorded (deleted with the actor's account).

user_agent.description: Caller user agent when recorded (back-office actions since ADR 0169).

oneOf.description: The actor's account when it still exists.

AuditFacets.description: Distinct values for the audit filters.

retention_days.description: How long rows are kept (days); null = kept (accounts' ids are erased on deletion).

AvatarImage.description: OpenAPI schema of an avatar image.

default_id.description: The default head in use (1-20), when `kind` is `default`.

chosen.description: `false` while the player never chose: the head comes from the account id.

Capabilities.description: What the account may do right now (age rules + parental controls + bans).

needs_guardian.description: Under the digital-consent age and no guardian linked yet.

discoverable_allowed.description: May appear in (and see) friend suggestions of players met (ADR 0145): adults only.

can_party_voice.description:
May talk in party voice (party members are friends; ADR 0176): the chat rules, plus a
linked guardian's `party_voice` switch.

can_server_voice.description:
May join the proximity voice of a Rustic Server, with strangers (ADR 0176): adults,
and minors whose linked guardian turned `server_voice` on.

tax_note.description: Legal display note (e.g. "Prices include VAT." / "Taxes calculated at checkout.").

collections.description: Active collections ordered by `sort`, then name.

trending.description: Product ids by trending rank (best first).

readable.description: The CDN folder is readable by the API.

truncated.description: The walk stopped at its file limit: the figures are a lower bound.

measured_at.description: When these figures were measured (cached for 10 minutes).

checkout_url.description: Stripe Checkout URL to open; `null` when fully paid by wallet or awaiting a guardian.

ClientKind.description: `web` receives the refresh token in an HttpOnly cookie instead of the body.

oneOf.description: Send every `heartbeat_interval_secs` (see `hello`). Presence expires after 3 missed beats.
Application-level ping; answered by `pong` with the same nonce.

uuid.description: Minecraft UUID hex of the friend's linked profile (Rustic user id hex if none).

to.description: Friend's Minecraft UUID hex (or Rustic user id).

address.description: `host[:port]` of the server the inviter is on.

id.description: `None` when the message was dropped as spam (answered the same way).

consent.description: The sender agreed to the processing of their message (required).

website.description: Honeypot: a hidden field people leave empty.

elapsed_ms.description: Milliseconds between the form showing and its sending.

ContentCatalogInfo.description: The kinds open to creators, their categories and the upload limits.

creator_sales_enabled.description: False until creator sales open (Stripe Connect): paid projects are shown, not sold.

ContentDownloadLink.description: A short-lived link to a version's file (private files need one in a browser).

ContentFileFacts.description: What a checked file says about itself (its manifest).

id.description: The manifest's id (content mods, native mods, `.hpack`, `.hshader`).

game.description: The game version it is for, when the manifest names one.

api.description:
A content mod's API line (`0.2`), a native mod's `native-1/<horizon>/<mixins>`, a
modpack's format, a shader pack's shader API, a resource/data pack's pack format.

hooks.description: A native mod's hook points version.

ContentLinks.description: Links shown on the project page (`https://` only).

ContentModeration.description: Owner and staff view of a project's moderation state.

pending_versions.description: Versions waiting for an admin (native mods).

review_note.description: The newest reviewer note on a rejected version.

ContentPrice.description:
`amount_cents` 0 = free. Paid creator content is shown with its price; buying it is not
available yet (ADR 0155).

description.description: Markdown page; only in `GET /v1/content/projects/{id}` (not in search hits).

gallery.description: Screenshots, in order (re-encoded on upload, served from Rustic's CDN).

oneOf.description: The Rustic account that publishes it (`None` for curated entries of a deleted admin).

verified.description: An admin confirmed the project matches its description.

latest_version.description: Newest version visible to the caller.

size.description: Size in bytes of the newest version's primary file.

review.description:
`pending` while a native mod waits for an admin (it is then private whatever its
visibility says).

marketplace.description: Hosted by Rustic's marketplace (uploaded by its creator) rather than curated.

oneOf.description: Owner and staff only: why it is under review, rejected or taken down.

approve.description:
`true` approves the version (the project becomes visible as its owner chose), `false`
rejects it with `note` as the reason.

ContentUpload.description: A staged upload, checked and kept until a publish request uses it (or it expires).

oneOf.description: Content files.

What the file's manifest says, in the JSON of `rusticmc_content::model::HorizonFacts`
(the launcher's compatibility verdicts read it). Marketplace versions only.

yanked.description: Yanked versions are listed to their owner and staff only.

review_note.description: Owner and staff only: the reviewer's note.

Conversation.description: One direct-message conversation (most recent first in `GET /v1/conversations`).

asset_version.description: Bundle version on the CDN (empty until published by the pipeline).

asset_hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the bundle: its CDN address and integrity check.

CosmeticSlot.description:
Cosmetic slots = the cosmetics format's categories (`packages/cosmetics-format`,
`Category`). Purely visual. There is deliberately no cape slot (docs/LEGAL.md).

subdomain_label.description: Request a free `<label>.<relay-domain>` (only when the feature is enabled).

name.description: 1-64 characters, shown to players in the launcher's voice panel.

zone.description: Registrable zone the records live in (e.g. `example.com`).

routing_active.description: True when the relay is authorised to route this hostname.

dns_records.description: Registrar-agnostic record set to create, with per-record live check results.

DailyOffers.description: Today's daily offers (one UTC day, same for everyone).

migration_version.description: The newest migration applied to the database.

migration_latest.description: The newest migration this API embeds.

available.description: `false` while the server has no Discord OAuth2 client configured (linking disabled).

invite_url.description: Invite to the Rustic Discord server, when configured.

case_id.description: The case the bot recorded for it.

DiscordActivityItem.description:
Something the bot did: a feed post or its removal, an automatic sanction, a back-office
action, a GitHub delivery.

DiscordAdminAction.description: A back-office request the bot applies on Discord.

DiscordContactNotice.description: The staff notice the Discord bot posts for a contact message (no email address).

reference.description: Short reference, also in the emails' subjects.

DiscordContentSnapshot.description:
The public snapshot of a marketplace project for the bot's feed (service token, scope
`discord`). `postable` is the API's decision: public, listed, not taken down, at least one
public version. When it is `false` the bot removes what it posted.

oneOf.description: `None` when nobody but the owner and staff may see the project.

page_url.description: The project's page on the website.

launcher_url.description: `rustic://content/rustic/<id>`: opens the project in the launcher.

pending.description: Outbox changes the bot has not consumed yet.

lag_seconds.description: Age of the oldest change not consumed (0 when caught up).

pending_actions.description: Back-office actions waiting for the bot.

DiscordLink.description: A Discord account linked to the caller's Rustic account (identity only: it never signs in).

discord_id.description: Discord user id (a snowflake, as a string).

global_name.description: Display name on Discord, when set.

avatar_url.description: Discord CDN avatar URL, when the account has one.

DiscordLinkFinishRequest.description: Step 2: the website's callback page posts what Discord returned.

DiscordLinkStart.description: Step 1: the website sends the browser to `authorize_url` (Discord's consent screen).

DiscordLinkState.description:
`GET /v1/integrations/discord/links/{discord_id}`: whether a Discord account is linked
(role sync). Never says to which Rustic account.

DiscordProfile.description:
`GET /v1/integrations/discord/profile`: only public data. A minor's Discord link and game
name are never revealed to others; lookups by game name never resolve a minor.

minecraft_name.description: Linked game profile name (adults only, or the member looking at their own profile).

discord_id.description: The Discord account this profile is linked to, when it may be shown.

is_self.description: The looked-up account is the asking Discord member's own.

oneOf.description:
What the asking member may see of the Rustic profile (ADR 0168): the profile's
visibility and section settings apply as on the website, the asking member being
whoever their Discord account is linked to. `None` from an older API.
Play statistics, when the profile shows them to the asking member.

DiscordProjectSummary.description: A public project in a Discord profile card.

DiscordServerSnapshot.description: The public snapshot of a server listing (ADR 0158) for the bot's feed.

DiscordServerSummary.description: A public server listing in a Discord profile card.

configured.description: False: no row saved, the bot keeps its environment.

DiscordStats.description: Public statistics of an account's published content and servers.

players_online.description: Players online right now on the account's public servers (last ping).

projects_by_kind.description: Public projects per kind (`mod`, `modpack`...), most first.

DiscordStoreSnapshot.description: A store product for the bot's feed (active products only).

DiscordThreshold.description: An automatic sanction at a number of active warnings.

duration_secs.description:
Mutes (up to 28 days) and temporary bans (up to 365 days); none for a kick or a
permanent ban.

DnsRecord.description:
A DNS record to create at the user's registrar (any registrar: by hand, or by the launcher
through the user's own registrar API keys). `name` is relative to the zone (`@` = apex).

name.description: Record name relative to the zone (what registrar APIs expect as the subdomain).

value.description: TXT content, CNAME target, or SRV `priority weight port target`.

required.description:
Required for verification. For routing, either the CNAME or the SRV record suffices
(apex domains cannot hold a CNAME: use SRV).

EmailAudience.description: Accounts a campaign would reach today (opted in, verified address, active).

configured.description: SMTP is configured (otherwise mails stay in memory).

emote.description: Emote id (`asset_ref` of an owned emote) or `null` to stop.

ErrorBody.description: Error envelope returned with every non-2xx status.

ErrorCounts.description: Answers of this API process (counted in memory since it started).

stripe_events_unprocessed_24h.description: Stripe webhook events received but not processed (last 24 hours).

message.description: Human readable message (English; the UI translates by `code`).

ExternalIdentity.description: A sign-in method linked to the account (`microsoft`).

key.description: Project id or slug (any source: `modrinth:<id>`, `horizon:<id>`, a bare slug...).

FairPlayDenyList.description: The authoritative fair-play deny list (X-ray, auto-clickers, hacks...).

gates.description: What the API refuses while it is off.

FeaturedServer.description: A server staff feature on the Launchpad and the Servers page.

address.description: `host` or `host:port` players type in the game.

verified.description: Staff checked the owner and the rules.

players_online.description: Not measured by the cloud yet: clients ping the server themselves.

server_name.description: The caller's own name for the server (from their presence), when `reason` is `server`.

seen_at.description: End of the most recent time together.

FriendSuggestions.description: `GET /v1/friends/suggestions` (ADR 0145). Both lists are most recent first, 10 at most.

discoverable.description: `false` when the caller opted out or is a minor: nothing is recorded, lists are empty.

played_with.description: Same party, or the same server for at least 10 minutes in total, in the last 14 days.

crossed.description: Same server at overlapping times in the last 14 days (not already in `played_with`).

GalleryRef.description: One gallery image to keep: an existing one by `url`, or a staged upload.

approvals_pending.description: Purchases waiting for a guardian's decision.

GdprRequest.description: A data-subject request in the register (export, deletion...), self-service or received.

username.description: The account's handle when recorded (`deleted account` after the purge).

due_at.description: The legal deadline (one month, GDPR art. 12(3)).

code.description: Shown once; only a hash is stored.
Give this code to the guardian; valid 7 days, single use.

HandoffResponse.description: Single-use code (60 s) the website hands to the launcher through `rustic://auth?code=`.

HeroCredit.description: Where the footage comes from and under which licence.

source_url.description: The page the clip was downloaded from.

HeroMedia.description: The video set behind the launcher's Launchpad and the website's account pages.

id.description: The set's content hash: its folder `media/hero/<id>/` on the CDN.

renditions.description: Every rendition; the clients pick by codec support, then by size.

builtin.description: No choice saved in the back-office: the set built into the API.

source.description:
A set id (8 to 64 hexadecimal characters), its manifest URL on the CDN
(`https://cdn…/media/hero/<id>/manifest.json`), or `default` for the built-in set.

reason.description: Why (3 to 500 characters), kept in the audit log.

HeroPoster.description: A still of the loop's first frame (the `poster` and the reduced-motion picture).

HeroRendition.description: One encoding of the hero loop, on the CDN.

mime.description:
The type with its codecs, for `<source type>`, `canPlayType` and
`MediaSource.isTypeSupported`: `video/mp4; codecs="av01.0.08M.08"`.

url.description: Absolute URL on the CDN (an immutable, content-addressed folder).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file (the launcher checks its cached copy against it).

HostingCatalog.description: Rustic Cloud hosting (coming soon): catalog preview, no provisioning.

priceCents.description: Monthly price, VAT included, minor units (indicative: not purchasable yet).

has_password.description: Whether the account can sign in with an email and password.

has_email.description: The account has an email address (needed to sign in with a password).

email_verified.description: That address is verified (a password can only be set on a verified address).

InviteCode.description:
An invite code for a server (ADR 0105): friends type it in the launcher, the cloud
resolves it to the server's route hostname.

hostname.description: `host` to join (the relay route hostname; port 25565 unless `port` is set).

LauncherPing.description: The launcher's daily anonymous ping (no account, no install id; ADR 0169).

mfa_token.description: Present when `status = mfa_required`: send it to `/v1/auth/login/mfa` (5 min).

signup_token.description: Present when `status = signup_required` (Microsoft sign-in): 10 min, single use.

email.description: The Microsoft account's email, when `status = signup_required`.

LookupRelation.description: How the caller relates to a looked-up user.

discoverable.description:
"Appear in suggestions of players I meet" as in effect: the setting (default on) and
`capabilities.discoverable_allowed` (always off for minors). ADR 0145.

avatar_url.description: The account's avatar (ADR 0168), as others see it.

read_at.description: When the recipient read it (read receipt); `null` while unread.

MicrosoftCompleteRequest.description:
The "complete your account" step of a Microsoft sign-up (same age gate and consent as
an email sign-up).

MicrosoftSignInRequest.description:
"Continue with Microsoft" (ADR 0090): the id_token the website got from Microsoft
(OIDC code flow + PKCE) and the nonce it generated.

MinecraftLinkChallenge.description:
Step 1 of the link (ADR 0011): a one-time `server_id`. The launcher then calls Mojang's
session server `POST /session/minecraft/join` with its own Minecraft token, the profile
UUID and this `server_id`. The token goes to Mojang only, never to Rustic Cloud.

MinecraftLinkFinishRequest.description: Step 2: the API asks Mojang `hasJoined(username, server_id)` and binds the returned UUID.

username.description: Current Minecraft username of the profile that joined.

oneOf.description: `null` when the Minecraft account is not linked to a Rustic account.

MyPlayStats.description: `GET /v1/me/play-stats`: the owner's own statistics, with every address.

raw_sessions.description: Raw sessions are kept 90 days, the totals until erased.

NewContentVersion.description: The first (or a new) version of a project.

version.description: Must equal the version in the file's manifest when it has one.

name.description: Display name; the version when empty.

game_versions.description: Game versions it is for (`26.3`); the manifest's when empty.

NewsActivity.description:
An entry of the updates feed: a push, a GitHub release or a CDN release. Entries of private
repositories never carry a URL (`url` and every commit's `url` are null). The pushes of one
monorepo sync to several mirror repositories are one entry listing them all in `repos`.

repo.description:
Repository name (`rustic`), or `launcher` / `edition` for CDN releases; for a grouped
push, the first public repository of `repos` (or the first one).

private.description: Whether `repo` is private (for a grouped push: every repository is private).

repos.description: Every repository of the entry, `repo` first (one for releases).

url.description: Compare page (push), release page (GitHub release) or the download page (CDN release).

commits.description:
The push's commits, newest first: at most 5 in lists, every recorded one (≤ 50) on the
entry itself.

commit_count.description: Commits in the push (can be more than `commits`).

body.description: Release notes (Markdown), only on the entry itself (`GET /v1/news/activity/{id}`).

NewsActivityCommit.description: One commit of a push. `url` is null for private repositories.

message.description: The first line of the message (secrets, tokens and emails redacted).

NewsActivityPage.description: A page of the updates feed, newest first.

next.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; null on the last page.

repos.description: Repositories that have entries (for filters), by name.

hidden.description: Hide the entry from the public feed (true) or show it again (false).

NewsActivityRepo.description: A repository of an entry: one, or every mirror the same commits were pushed to (ADR 0178).

url.description: That repository's compare page; null for a private repository.

NewsContributor.description: A person who committed to the organisation's repositories (ADR 0178).

commits.description: Commits across every repository (GitHub's contributors statistics).

avatar_url.description:
The avatar, served by this API (`/v1/news/contributors/{login}/avatar?v=…`); null when
there is none (the website draws an identicon).

hidden.description: Hide the contributor from the website (true) or show them again (false).

NewsContributorsPage.description: The contributors wall, most commits first.

total.description: Contributors shown on the website (can be more than `items`).

body.description: Markdown body (rendered as text by the clients; no raw HTML).

url.description: Where "Read more" goes: the external link when set, else the website's news page.

version.description: Version the item is about (patch notes), if any.

published.description: Publish now (true) or keep as a draft (false).

OfficialProject.description: One project of the official account with every version (yanked and pending included).

OfficialPublisher.description: The official Rustic publisher account and what it published (ADR 0166, staff only).

account.description: The account (`official: true`); it never signs in, staff publish as it.

item_ids.description: Cosmetic items this line grants ("Equip now" after checkout).

OrderTimelineEvent.description:
One step of an order's history: `order` (its own dates), `stripe` (a webhook event as
recorded) or `audit` (an audit row about it).

monthly_spend_limit_minor.description: Monthly cap in minor units of `spend_limit_currency`; `null` = no cap.

party_voice.description: Party voice with friends (ADR 0176; on by default, off when chat is disabled).

server_voice.description: The proximity voice of Rustic Servers, with strangers (ADR 0176; off by default).

pending_invites.description: Invites sent and still pending (who was asked and has not answered).

PartyMessage.description: A message of the party's text chat.

PartySettingsRequest.description: `PATCH /v1/parties/{id}` (leader only): a field left out is kept.

PartyVoice.description: How party members hear each other (ADR 0176).

proximity.description:
`true`: members on the same server hear each other by distance in game; `false`:
everyone at full volume, wherever they are.

range.description: Blocks beyond which a member is silent in proximity mode (8-128, default 48).

PendingMinor.description: A minor below the digital consent age with no guardian linked yet (or no birth date).

PlaySessionReport.description:
`POST /v1/me/play-sessions`: the game started, or moved (menu, a world, a server). The
cloud times everything itself; the launcher only says where the player is.

session_id.description: The launcher's id for this run of the game (one per launch).

server_address.description: The server's address as typed, for `server` (LAN and private addresses are not kept).

recording.description: `false` when the account turned play statistics off: nothing was recorded.

PremiumWaitlist.description: "Premium: coming soon" waitlist status of the caller.

PresenceIcon.description:
`POST /v1/me/presence-icons` (launcher ADR 0173): a Discord Rich Presence small image (the
server's favicon or the world's icon) as the CDN serves it: a 64x64 PNG named by its
SHA-256, the same for every player who sent the same picture.

amount_minor.description: Final amount the customer pays, in minor units.

tax_inclusive.description: True when `amount_minor` includes VAT (EU, UK, CH display rule).

oneOf.description: The price actually charged today (the discounted one while a daily offer runs).

owned.description: Only set for authenticated catalog requests.

featured.description: Highlighted by staff (e.g. a large card).

oneOf.description: Today's daily offer on this product in the requested currency, if any.

ProductOffer.description: A daily offer (ADR 0091): the same for every buyer, visible in advance, no random draw.

reference_minor.description:
EU Omnibus reference (Directive 98/6/EC art. 6a): lowest price applied to the product
in this currency during the 30 days before the offer day, in minor units.

ends_at.description: When the offer ends (next UTC midnight).

ProfileAccess.description: What the viewer was allowed to see.

oneOf.description: The public directory listing the player is on, when they share their server.

on_server.description: On a server that is not a public listing (or not shared): "on a server".

last_seen_at.description: Last time the player was online (to the minute).

verified_creator.description: At least one verified marketplace project.

oneOf.description: `moderator` or `admin`, when the staff member shows it.

users.description: Friends the viewer may see the profile of (at most 24).

ProfilePlace.description: A public directory listing named on a profile.

oneOf.description: The server's public listing; `None` for a private server or singleplayer.

ProfileSections.description: Per-section choices. A section never reaches further than the profile itself.

stats.description: Hours played, servers played, recently played, sessions.

activity.description: Online now / last seen and the current activity.

servers.description: The account's public server directory listings.

game_name.description: The linked game profile name (never shown to others for a minor).

ProfileServerStat.description:
One server in the statistics. Servers that are not public directory listings are shown
to others as one "other servers" line (`listing` empty); the owner also sees `address`.

oneOf.description: The public directory listing this address belongs to (slug, name, icon).

address.description: Only for the owner of the profile (their own data), never for others.

servers.description: Most played first (at most 8 listed servers, then one line for the others).

ProfileVisibility.description:
Who may open a profile page. Minors are never `public` (it is stored but shown as
`friends`).

PublicBanner.description: A banner as the website or the launcher shows it, in the asked language.

lang.description: The language of the text (the asked one, or `en` as the fallback).

updated_at.description: Changes when the banner is edited: a dismissal is remembered per id and version.

PublicProfile.description:
`GET /v1/profiles/{username}`: the page `rustic-launcher.com/account/<username>`. Every
section is `None` when the viewer may not see it.

indexable.description: Search engines may index the page (a public profile seen by anyone).

oneOf.description: The owner's own view: what applies to others.

PublicUser.description: A user as seen by other users (no email, no date of birth).

official.description:
The official Rustic account (ADR 0166): shown with an "Official" mark. It publishes
Rustic's own content and never signs in.

avatar_url.description:
The account's avatar (a 64x64 PNG on the CDN, ADR 0168): a chosen default head, the
head of an uploaded skin, or the default head assigned from the account id. `None`
only from services that cannot build CDN URLs.

PublishContentRequest.description: Publishes a new project with its first version (multi-step form of the website).

slug.description:
`[a-z0-9_-]{2,64}`; the project id. For a content mod, native mod, `.hpack` or
`.hshader`, it must be the manifest's id (`-` read as `_`).

accept_terms.description:
The publishing agreement: the creator owns the rights, the content follows the rules
and the fair-play policy. Must be `true`.

PurchaseConsent.description:
EU consumer law: explicit request for immediate execution and acknowledgement of the
loss of the 14-day withdrawal right for digital content. Both must be `true`.

wording_version.description: Version of the consent wording displayed (see `GET /v1/store/legal`).

country.description: ISO country of the buyer (VAT rules).

use_wallet.description: Spend wallet credit (redeemed gift cards) first.

marked.description: Messages marked read by this call.

RecordCheck.description: Result of the last DNS check of one expected record.

refresh_token.description: Required for the launcher; the web app sends the cookie instead.

amount_minor.description: Minor units; none: everything still refundable (a full refund, items revoked).

route_hostname.description:
Unique route name `<route-id>.<relay-host>`, always routed: the CNAME/SRV target for
custom domains (ADR 0013), also usable directly by players.

subdomain.description: `<label>.<relay-domain>` when the optional free subdomain feature is enabled.

hostnames.description: Hostnames the relay is authorised to route (verified domains + subdomain).

token.description: Tunnel token for the relay handshake (HS256 JWT, relay ADR 0101, docs/API.md).

hostnames.description: Permanent hostnames (verified custom domains, optional free subdomain).

temp_hostnames.description: Temporary hostnames with their lease expiry.

installs_yesterday.description: Launchers of this version that pinged yesterday (UTC).

share_yesterday.description: Their share of yesterday's pings, 0 to 1.

pings_7d.description: Pings of the last 7 days (an install pings at most once a day).

RemovePasswordRequest.description:
Removes the password (ADR 0168): allowed only while another sign-in method (Microsoft)
stays linked.

oneOf.description: A marketplace project report (the target is its owner).
A server listing report (the target is its owner). ADR 0158.
A voice room or the party chat (ADR 0176).
The reported party chat message.
Where it happened: a voice room or the party chat (ADR 0176).

party_message_id.description: A party chat message the target sent (`context` = `party_chat`).

SectionVisibility.description: Who sees one section of a visible profile.

body.description: 1-2000 characters. Passed through the profanity filter hook.

ServerListing.description: A server in the directory. Lists leave `description` out (`null`); the detail has it.

address.description: `host` or `host:port` players type in the game (lowercase).

description.description: Markdown (the website's small subset; never raw HTML). Detail only.

engine.description: What the server runs: vanilla Horizon or Rustic Server (plugins).

game_version.description: Game version players need (`26.3`), when the owner said.

requires_rustic_edition.description: Players need the Rustic edition client (cosmetics, companion, native mods).

verified.description: Staff checked the owner and the rules.

featured.description: A staff pick (the Launchpad, the hero carousels).

plays_7d.description:
"Play" presses from the launcher over the last 7 days (anonymous, one per player and
6 hours): the trending signal with the player count.

oneOf.description: Owner and staff only.

ServerListingCatalog.description: The directory's vocabulary and limits (the forms and filters read it).

languages.description: Languages listings use most, most used first (filters).

ServerListingModeration.description: What the owner and staff see besides the public page.

featured_rank.description: Position among staff picks (lower first); `null` when not featured.

ServerListingRequest.description: Create (`POST`) a listing. Published at once after the automatic checks.

accept_rules.description: The owner accepts the server listing rules (no impersonation, honest description).

ServerListingStatus.description: Last status the cloud read with the server list ping (public addresses only, every ~10 min).

motd.description: Plain text of the MOTD (formatting codes removed, at most 200 characters).

version.description: The version name the server announced.

oneOf.description: Read receipt: `reader_id` read the conversation with you up to `read_at`.

The user accepted a server invitation (e.g. from the in-game companion): the launcher
should (re)start the game into `address`.
`party = null` when the party was disbanded or the user left/was kicked.
A message of the party's text chat, to every member (the sender too). ADR 0176.
The session behind this socket was revoked: the server closes the socket after this.

ServiceHealth.description: One service as the API sees it.

SetDailyOffersRequest.description: Replaces the offers of one day (at most 12).

SetPasswordRequest.description: First password of an account created with Microsoft.

product_ids.description: Ranks 1..n in this order; every other product loses its rank.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (age rules depend on it).

privacy_policy_version.description: Version of the privacy policy the user accepted at signup.

guardian_required.description:
True when the user is under the digital-consent age of their country: features are
restricted until a guardian links the account.

SkinPng.description: OpenAPI schema of the binary PNG body.

emotes.description: Emotes the account owns (the wheel shows at most 8).

StatKpi.description: A headline number for the range, with the same measure over the previous range.

unit.description: `count`, `hours` or a currency code for amounts in minor units.

subscriptions_offered.description: False while no subscription product exists (Rustic Premium is a waitlist).

hero.description: Shown as the store's hero banner.

product_ids.description: In display order; only active products of this catalog response.

TempHostnameLease.description:
A temporary relay hostname lease for a server running on the user's machine, plus a
relay token that already carries it.

renew_before.description: Renew before this instant to keep the same hostname.

access_token.description: Short-lived JWT (15 min) for `Authorization: Bearer` and the realtime socket.

refresh_token.description: Opaque rotating refresh token (30 days). Absent for `client = web` (cookie instead).

secret.description: Base32 secret (show once, or render `otpauth_url` as a QR code client-side).

UpdateCollectionRequest.description: Every field optional; `product_ids` replaces the list (in order) when present.

UpdateContentProjectRequest.description: Every field optional: only the ones sent change.

date_of_birth.description: Only accepted while unset (accounts created with Microsoft).

discoverable.description:
Friend suggestions opt-out (ADR 0145). `true` is refused (`discoverable_not_allowed`)
for minors; `false` also deletes the recorded sightings at once.

share_server.description: When false, `activity.server_address` is dropped before fan-out.

UpdateProductRequest.description: Every field optional; `prices` and `item_ids` replace the whole set when present.

UpdatePromoCodeRequest.description:
The editable part of a code (the code, its discount and currency are fixed once created:
orders refer to them).

UpdateServerListingRequest.description: Edit (`PATCH`): absent fields stay as they are.

UserLookup.description: Exact-match result of `GET /v1/users/lookup`, shown before sending a friend request.

minecraft_name.description: Linked Minecraft profile name. Hidden for minors unless it is what was searched.

request_id.description: Pending incoming request id when `relation` is `incoming_request`.

ttl_secs.description: Seconds the roster stays valid without a new one.

enabled.description: `false` when the owner disabled the server in the cloud: the plugin stops sending.

VoiceRosterRequest.description: `POST /v1/voice/servers/{id}/roster` from the proximity voice plugin (bearer = its key).

players.description: The Minecraft UUIDs online now (32 hex or dashed), at most 500.

range.description: The plugin's range in blocks (8-128, default 48).

VoiceServer.description: A Rustic Server registered for proximity voice (its owner's view).

online.description: Players in the last roster the plugin sent (0 once it is stale).

VoiceServerKey.description: The key is shown once: it goes in the plugin's `config.toml`.

VoiceToken.description: What the launcher needs to join a voice room on Rustic's SFU (LiveKit).

token.description: A LiveKit access token for `room` only, short-lived (join before `expires_at`).

identity.description: The caller's identity in the room (their Rustic user id).

proximity.description: Distance-based volume (always for a server room; the party's setting otherwise).

range.description: Blocks beyond which a speaker is silent.

server_name.description: The server's name (its owner's label), for a server room.

WaitlistRequest.description: Also accepts the hosting crate's `{"region", "expectedPlayers"}` shape.

ttl.description: Seconds this answer may be cached (60-3600).

players.description: By UUID hex; players wearing nothing are left out.

playing.description: Emotes playing now, by UUID hex.

WornItem.description: One worn cosmetic: where its bundle is on the CDN.

players.description: Up to 64 Minecraft UUIDs (hex, dashes accepted).
